say: Employees has five rows. Two have a NULL department.
cap: Employees has *5* rows. Two have a *NULL* dept.

say: COUNT star. COUNT dept. COUNT DISTINCT dept.
Pause and guess all three numbers.
Hint: two of them skip NULLs.
COUNT star counts every row. Five.
COUNT dept skips the NULLs. Three.
COUNT DISTINCT also drops the repeated IT. Two.
Same result in Oracle and PostgreSQL.
